Director, Sales - New Logo

The Role
The Director, Sales - New Logo leads a team of Strategic Account Executives responsible for creating and closing new enterprise customer relationships at Ping Identity. This leader owns new-logo strategy, territory design, pipeline creation, forecast discipline, deal execution, partner activation, customer relationships, and team development to deliver predictable, durable growth.

PagerDuty, Inc. (NYSE: PD) is the global leader in AI-first digital operations. Senior Sales Finance Manager
PagerDuty | Strategic Finance
About the Team
Strategic Finance provides the analytical rigor and data-driven insight that drives decisions across PagerDuty. The team's purpose is to help PagerDuty develop and achieve its short and long-term financial goals, and to inform, articulate, and shape the company's growth trajectory - from how we forecast the business to how we tell that story internally and externally.

About the Role
PagerDuty is looking for a Senior Manager to serve as the primary finance business partner for our go-to-market organization. You will own the analytical backbone of how we plan, forecast, and measure our sales engine - this includes ARR and revenue forecasting, expense management, variance analysis and headcount planning.
This is a high-visibility role. Your work will directly inform CRO and CFO decision-making, quarterly guidance inputs, and board-level reporting. We are looking for someone who is highly analytical and strategic, and who can move seamlessly between the granular details of a forecast model and the big-picture "so what" for leadership. We are actively building an AI-first finance function and expect this role to lead by example and modernize how work gets done.

What You'll Do

• Act as a strategic partner to the sales leadership team. Leverage deep financial knowledge to provide expert guidance, actionable insights, and recommendations on financial strategy, investments, and resource allocation to support company growth.

• Own the GTM operating model. Build and maintain pipeline, retention and ARR forecasts; drive weekly forecast cadence with sales leadership and reconcile bottoms-up views against top-down targets. Pressure test gross and net retention assumptions through cohort analysis and renewal pipeline health. Translate ARR forecasts into revenue forecasts using a revenue waterfall.

• Drive annual planning cycles. Lead the sales finance workstream in annual planning and quarterly forecasting, including S&M expense-to-revenue targets, productivity assumptions, and scenario modeling.

• Own expense management. Provide variance analysis for the sales organization, highlighting risks and opportunities.

• Support Sales Compensation. Partner with Sales Operations, Revenue Operations and Accounting to manage headcount, capacity planning and commission design, aligning to the broader go-to-market strategy.

• Elevate tooling. Build durable, self-serve reporting (dashboards, models and AI-assisted workflows) that reduce manual cycles and raise the altitude of the team's work.

• Communicate at executive level. Prepare crisp analyses and materials for the CRO, CFO, CEO, and Board; translate complex data into clear decisions.

What We're Looking For

• 6–10+ years of progressive finance experience, with at least 3 years in FP&A or sales/GTM finance at a SaaS or subscription software company; public-company experience strongly preferred

• Strong financial modeling skills

• Strong SQL skills; comfortable pulling and validating your own data

• Deep fluency in SaaS metrics

• Experience with pricing/packaging transitions, consumption models, or usage-based revenue a strong plus

• Solid grounding in core accounting concepts and revenue waterfall mechanics

• Demonstrated experience partnering cross-functionally

• Strong executive presence - comfortable challenging assumptions while maintaining trusted relationships

• Meticulous attention to detail

• Ability to lead projects and provide clear guidance to others

• Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced, dynamic environment

• Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team

• AI fluency using Claude to improve how Finance works, not just what Finance produces

• Familiarity with an EPM tool such as Anaplan or Pigment

• Experience using Salesforce to understand opportunities, accounts and customers

• Familiarity with Zuora and Zuora Revenue is a plus

• BA/BS in Finance, Economics, or related field; MBA/CFA a plus

Why This Role
You'll have direct exposure to how PagerDuty plans, forecasts, and reports on the business - with a seat at the table for decisions that shape the GTM function with a direct line to the CRO and Sales leadership. This is a role for someone who wants ownership, takes action and has a clear point of view on the business.

The base salary range for this position is 131,000 - 220,000 USD. This role may also be eligible for bonus, commission, and/or benefits.

Within the range, we determine pay for an individual based on a number of factors including market location, job-related knowledge, skills/competencies and experience.

PagerDuty operates a hybrid work model with offices in 8 major cities: Atlanta, Lisbon, London, San Francisco, Santiago, Sydney, Tokyo, and Toronto. While we offer flexibility within our established locations, we cannot employ candidates residing in:
Location restrictions:

Our values guide how we support customers, collaborate with colleagues, develop products, and foster a culture of belonging. They define not just our actions, but what it means to be Dutonian.

PagerDuty has four key dimensions that define our Leadership Impact: Lead Self, Lead the Team, Lead the Business, and Lead the Future. Each dimension has three associated competencies to give leaders a shared language for guiding their development, career, promotion, and succession planning discussions. Our Manager Expectations serve as a practical guide for managers to understand their responsibilities, prioritize their efforts, and drive engagement and performance.

jobs.description:
Headquarters: European Union - Remote
Wrike is the most powerful work management platform. Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work.

Wrike is our people, not a place. As a distributed team, we own our growth, stay globally connected, and rely on the product we build to deliver impactful work alongside brilliant minds. You'll have real ownership over meaningful work, a global team that has your back, and the flexibility to do your best work your way. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

Our vision: A world where everyone is free to focus on their most purposeful work, together.

About the Role:
You'll help build the very AI-powered platform you use every day, with real autonomy over the features you ship. Wrike is opening a new talent track for builders- senior engineers who take a feature from a rough idea to a production system on their own, and who use AI as a genuine multiplier rather than a buzzword. This isn’t a backfill for an existing seat. It’s a newly created role for someone who already operates autonomously and wants to keep doing that inside a company with real scale, real users, and daily production deployments. You take a high-level idea, figure out what actually needs to be built by talking to the right people, and ship it end-to-end: backend logic, frontend touches where needed, automated and manual testing, infra, and the dozen adjacent things a real feature needs. You read the existing codebase with judgment- reusing what’s solid, rebuilding what isn’t, and refusing to leave tech debt for the next person.
AI is not optional here. You’re expected to work AI-native: using it daily to move faster, and knowing when to push back when it suggests something that doesn’t hold up. If you’ve written your own automation, scripts, or internal tooling to remove friction from your own workflow, that’s exactly the instinct we’re hiring for.

Your Impact:

• Take ambiguous, high-level product ideas and turn them into a concrete technical plan- by asking the right people the right questions, not waiting for a fully written spec

• Designed, built, and shipped end-to-end features across the full stack- including a Java/Spring backend, REST APIs, data layer, testing, infrastructure touches, and rollout- while utilizing modern frontend technologies like TypeScript, React 19, Microfrontends, and Module Federation, alongside legacy Dart components.

• Navigate a real, living codebase- deciding what to reuse, what to rebuild, and holding the line against unnecessary tech debt

• Think in systems: anticipate second-order effects before they become incidents

• Make technical and product tradeoff calls yourself, manage the risk, and push things over the finish line

• Use AI tools (Cursor, Claude/Codex, our internal AI portal and MCP) as a daily part of how you build- including writing your own automations and skills where they save real time

• Challenge AI output and product asks alike when they don’t hold up- critical thinking is part of the job, not a side skill

Your Qualifications:

• Strong full-stack engineering experience, with deep comfort in Java (21), Spring, REST APIs, and SQL, TypeScript, React 19

• A track record of owning features or systems end-to-end, not just executing a fully-specified ticket

• Experience navigating and improving an existing, non-trivial codebase- this isn’t a greenfield role

• Advanced, hands-on use of AI coding tools as part of your daily workflow- you’re past the learning curve already

• Comfort making decisions under ambiguity and owning the outcome, good or bad

• Backgrounds we tend to see succeed here: technical founders, early engineers at startups who built the first version, small-company CTOs/Heads of Engineering, or senior engineers with active, recent open-source or side-project work

Our Stack:

• Java (21), Spring, REST APIs, SQL

• TypeScript, React 19, Redux, Dart

• PostgreSQL, Redis, RabbitMQ

• Unit/integration testing, Java web stack

• AI tooling: Cursor, Claude/Codex, Zencoder, internal AI portal, internal MCP

jobs.title: Product User Research, Intern
jobs.description:
ABOUT SARVAM AI

Sarvam AI is building India's sovereign AI stack, spanning foundational models, infrastructure and applications. Our mission is to make powerful AI accessible and useful for India, building technology that works across languages, industries and real-world use cases.

As we continue to build and scale our products, understanding how people interact with them becomes increasingly important. We're looking for a curious and research-oriented intern to help us understand our users better and shape the experiences we build.



THE ROLE

As a Product User Research Intern, you'll work closely with our product, design and engineering teams to understand user behaviour, identify friction points and uncover opportunities to improve our products.

You'll interact directly with developers, product managers and founders, study how they use Sarvam's products, and translate your findings into actionable insights that influence product and design decisions.

This is an opportunity to work on a new user research function at Sarvam, helping establish research practices and processes from the ground up. You'll also get ownership of a primary product area and the opportunity to see your research translate into real product improvements.



WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

 - Understand our users: Conduct user interviews, surveys and usability studies with developers, PMs and founders to understand their needs, behaviours and challenges.

 - Improve product experiences: Research user journeys across Sarvam's developer console, playground, API documentation and applications. Identify friction points across onboarding, API key creation, first API calls, billing and other key workflows.

 - Study developer journeys: Analyse the developer funnel, from sign-up to making the first API call and eventually becoming a paying user. Understand where users drop off and, more importantly, why.

 - Test and evaluate designs: Conduct usability testing on existing interfaces and new prototypes, run preference and A/B tests, and benchmark experiences against other developer products.

 - Turn research into insights: Analyse qualitative and quantitative data, identify patterns and present clear recommendations to product, design, growth and support teams.

 - Build the research practice: Help establish research playbooks, interview templates, participant recruitment processes and a research repository that can scale with the team.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Strong curiosity about user behaviour and a genuine interest in understanding why people use products the way they do.

 - Comfortable speaking with users, conducting interviews and asking thoughtful, unbiased questions.

 - Technical fluency — you should be comfortable reading API documentation, making basic API calls using tools like Postman, curl or Python, and understanding what might have gone wrong when an API fails.

 - Comfortable working with data, analysing spreadsheets and interpreting product funnels or dashboards.

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate research findings into clear insights and recommendations.

 - Familiarity with AI tools and developer products, and an interest in exploring how they can improve research workflows.


GOOD TO HAVE

 - Experience with SQL or product analytics tools such as Mixpanel, Amplitude or Metabase.

 - Familiarity with user research methodologies, usability testing and survey design.

 - Experience reviewing Figma prototypes or conducting user interviews.

 - Previous research projects, internships or personal projects involving products you've built or shipped.

 - Fluency in one or more Indian languages.


WHO CAN APPLY?

 - Final-year students or graduates who have completed their studies within the last 12 months.

 - Candidates from engineering, psychology, economics, design or social science backgrounds.

 - Individuals who can commit to a full-time, 6-month, in-office internship in Bengaluru.


WHAT YOU'LL GET

 - The opportunity to help build Sarvam's user research function from the ground up.

 - Direct exposure to product, design and engineering teams working on India's sovereign AI ecosystem.

 - Hands-on experience researching developer products and real-world AI applications.

 - Ownership of meaningful research projects with findings that directly influence product decisions.

 - An opportunity to work closely with experienced product leaders and learn how research translates into better products.

 - Potential for a pre-placement offer (PPO) based on performance.

Inclusion signifies the practice of granting equal access to opportunities and resources for all employees, particularly those who might otherwise be excluded or marginalized. It ensures that everyone feels a sense of belonging, value, support, and respect as an individual.
Belonging
Belonging reflects the affinity and positive relationships that develop among employees from diverse backgrounds when businesses actively promote diversity, equity, and inclusion in the workplace.

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Rater - Spanish speakers in Spain
jobs.description:
Join our elite team of Senior Raters as a critical contributor to high-quality validation data that directly influences product development and quality assurance for leading search engines and AI technologies.
This flexible, remote opportunity allows you to apply your analytical and research skills to evaluate search results and AI-generated content while contributing to the development of high-quality AI systems.

A Day in the Life of a Quality Assurance Rater
In this role, you'll conduct analytical assessments of search results and AI responses, providing ratings and feedback that help improve AI model performance and search quality.
Your work will maintain high quality standards and deliver the accuracy our clients depend on.
You'll evaluate a variety of rating tasks, analyze content with attention to detail, conduct research to support rating decisions, and identify guideline gaps or task inconsistencies.
You'll also participate in training and calibration sessions while contributing feedback to improve rating processes and guidelines.

Key Responsibilities

• Evaluate search results and AI-generated content for quality, relevance, accuracy, and usefulness.

• Conduct online research to verify information and support rating decisions.

• Apply rating guidelines consistently while maintaining quality standards.

• Document edge cases, guideline gaps, and task-related issues.

• Provide clear written feedback and rationale for ratings when required.

• Participate in training, calibration sessions, and ongoing quality reviews.

• Meet productivity expectations while maintaining high-quality work.

TELUS Digital AI Community
Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of 1 million+ contributors from diverse backgrounds who help our customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and make an impact supporting the machine learning models of some of the world’s largest brands.
Qualification path

Candidates will complete project-specific training and qualification assessments before joining the program. Ongoing work will be subject to regular quality assurance reviews and performance monitoring.

Basic Requirements

• Working as a freelancer with excellent communication skills in Spanish & English.

• Resident in Spain for the last 5 consecutive years.

• Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural affairs.

• Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and research skills.

• Experience using web browsers, search engines, and online research tools.

• Daily access to a reliable broadband internet connection, smartphone, and personal computer.

• Demonstrated research capability through professional background OR strong track record of self-directed research and information verification

• Ability to work independently and follow detailed guidelines consistently.

• High level of creativity and logical skills with the ability to achieve consistent targets

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in quality assurance, content moderation, data annotation, research, journalism, editing, or information verification.

• Familiarity with AI technologies, search engines, and digital content ecosystems.

• Subject matter expertise in areas such as Popular Culture, Social Sciences, STEM, Medicine, Law, Finance, or Engineering.

• Additional language skills may be beneficial depending on project requirements.

Equal Opportunity
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for a contractual relationship without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. At TELUS Digital AI, we are proud to offer equal opportunities and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive community. All aspects of selection are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence, and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer (Interfaces)
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote
About the Team
As a Staff Software Engineer at Netlify, you'll join a collaborative team that values continuous learning, mutual support, and shared growth. Together, we create tools that help developers build faster, more intuitively, and with greater impact. Our Experience team owns the core product experience at Netlify, which is every way a human or an agent interacts with the platform, from our React-based web application to CLI, MCP, SDK, and API. If users interact with it directly, it's likely ours. We're reimagining how developers experience web development by thoughtfully integrating AI into our workflows - not as a novelty, but as a practical tool that enhances how we build the web.
With our team, you'll help set technical direction for our product area, mentor a highly senior team of engineers, and shape user experiences that serve millions of developers. You'll work closely with Product, Design, and engineering leadership, and partner with teams across the organization to build, iterate, and scale meaningful solutions. You'll have the autonomy to guide what we build and how, and the influence to bring others along with you, all while staying hands-on in the codebase.
We're looking for thoughtful engineers who enjoy owning problems end to end, collaborating across disciplines, and solving complex technical challenges for products that millions of developers rely on every day. AI is a foundational part of how we build, so we value engineers who are excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI-assisted workflows while continuing to apply strong engineering fundamentals. We believe the best engineering happens when talented people are trusted to solve difficult problems together, share what they're learning, and create space for different perspectives to shape better solutions. With our team, you'll have real ownership from day one - not a tiny slice of a massive codebase. Engineers here are trusted to make decisions, shape technical direction, and move quickly while collaborating closely with Product and Design.
What You'll Do

• Use your deep expertise in full-stack development (TypeScript, JavaScript, Go, and React) to ship reliable, scalable, performant code across our product suite, and set the patterns that others on the team and across the org follow.

• Own the technical direction for our product area, including the web app, CLI, MCP, SDK, API, and docs, by defining architecture and roadmap alongside your manager, Product, and Design, and make tradeoffs explicit so decisions are easy to understand and revisit

• Lead large, ambiguous projects that span multiple teams from conception to delivery, such as our application rewrite and upcoming CLI rework, writing RFCs, driving alignment, and managing risk and timelines

• Design and evolve user-facing features and product APIs for both humans and agents, recognizing that the best interface isn’t always a React application. Build them to scale to millions of developers worldwide, with a clear view of reliability, performance, and long-term maintainability.

• Make thoughtful product and interface decisions on your own with the overall customer experience top of mind

• Set the bar for engineering practices - testing, documentation, observability, and performance optimization - and lead how the team pragmatically uses AI tools, sharing what works and what doesn't

• Turn ambiguity into clear plans, guiding both early-stage prototypes and production-ready applications that directly impact user experience and business metrics

• Mentor and grow engineers through code reviews, design reviews, pairing, and sponsorship, raising the technical level of the whole team

• Practice proactive async communication and create visibility across projects by documenting your workflows and decision-making clearly

• Participate in on-call rotations, lead incident follow-up, and drive continuous improvement efforts that reduce technical debt and prevent recurring problems

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams and engineering leadership to shape user flows that enhance the developer experience across our platform, and contribute to hiring and team growth

What You'll Bring

• Deep expertise in TypeScript and JavaScript, with a long track record of designing, shipping, and maintaining production-quality software in modern full-stack environments

• A history of building interfaces developers use directly, such as web apps, CLIs, APIs, SDKs, or other dev tools, and a strong sense of what works well for developers (and, by extension, agents)

• Passion for building strong user-facing experiences, including working with React and modern frontend architecture and making architectural decisions that hold up as products and teams grow, paired with the backend knowledge to design software well beyond the UI

• Strong product and design instincts. This isn’t about visual polish - it’s about making thoughtful decisions about how users interact with a product.

• Strong proficiency with Go and/or Ruby for backend services and API development, with a thoughtful approach to reliability and performance

• Hands-on experience with React and modern frontend architecture, including making architectural decisions that hold up as products and teams grow

• Demonstrated ability to raise the technical bar: providing direction to senior and staff-level engineers, distributing ownership, mentoring, shaping standards, and influencing decisions beyond your own team

• Extensive experience delivering features and services that serve large user bases, including designing for scale and operating systems in production

• A track record of leading technically complex, cross-team projects from ambiguous problem to shipped outcome, including writing RFCs and building consensus

• Demonstrated ability to raise the technical bar: mentoring senior and mid-level engineers, shaping standards, and influencing decisions beyond your own team

• Experience writing high-quality, testable code that's reliable and maintainable over time, and setting that expectation for others

• Proficiency using and experimenting with AI-assisted development tools, with sound judgment about when and how to apply them and the ability to help others do the same

• Experience contributing to open-source projects or working in public codebases is a plus

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, especially in asynchronous, remote-first environments, with the ability to explain tradeoffs to engineers, leadership, and non-technical partners

• Critical thinking abilities and a solution-oriented approach to complex technical challenges, with the judgment to prioritize and say no when needed

• A collaborative approach to problem-solving with curiosity about how your work supports teammates, users, and broader goals

• Growth mindset and openness to learning new tools, technologies, and best practices

• Passion for working in a collaborative environment with diverse teams across distributed locations

This Role is a Great Fit If

• You're energized by building user-facing products and features that directly impact millions of developers' daily workflows

• You thrive in collaborative environments, working closely with your team and cross-functionally to turn ideas into reality

• You enjoy the autonomy and influence of staff-level work - setting technical direction, writing RFCs, and driving decisions across teams while staying connected to the people doing the work

• You find satisfaction in making other engineers better, whether through mentoring, design reviews, or setting a clear example

• You see ambiguity as a creative opportunity and can navigate uncertainty to build practical solutions and bring clarity to others

• You see AI as a multiplier for your skills, not a shortcut, and can articulate where it helps, where it doesn't, and how you use it

• You're excited by new tools, challenges, and opportunities to grow, even when they feel a little uncomfortable at first

• You want to work on a fully remote team that believes in autonomy, transparency, and building a better web, together

Applying
Not sure you meet 100% of our qualifications? Please apply anyway!
When applying please include:
A resume or short listing of your job history & skills (link to a LinkedIn profile would be fine). We appreciate a cover letter explaining why you would enjoy working in this role at Netlify to get to know you a bit better, though this is not required and will not impact your application. Our mission is to “build a better web” and that cannot be done without a diversity of skill sets, backgrounds and thoughts.
Of everything we've ever built at Netlify, we are most proud of our team. Netlify is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are devoted to building a team of people with diverse backgrounds and lifestyles. Driving equality empowers our team, enables us to innovate, and helps us maintain a more inclusive environment. We don’t discriminate against employees or applicants based on gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, race, military/veteran status, citizenship, pregnancy status, or any other differences. If we can do anything to provide a better interview, i.e. accommodate a disability, then please let us know by emailing accommodations@netlify.com.
About Netlify
Netlify is a platform that lets you create, share, and run anything on the web: a website, an app, an agent experience, whatever you can dream up. Use your own tools or ours to build it, collaborate with your team, get it live, and keep it running. Anyone, from people just starting out to seasoned developers, can create pro-level web experiences that really work, really well.
We are a Series D company that has raised over $200M from investors such as Andreessen Horowitz, Kleiner Perkins, EQT, Bessemer, BOND, and Menlo Ventures. As a fully distributed company, we aim to create a company culture where the best idea can come from anywhere and strive to be thoughtful, compassionate, and collaborative in our work. If this sounds like something you’d like to be part of, we’re excited to connect with you!
At Netlify, we are committed to a compensation philosophy that prioritizes fairness and equity, positions our employee compensation competitively in the market, recognizes and rewards performance, and takes a comprehensive approach to our rewards package. We anchor our compensation philosophy on a market-based approach, therefore salary ranges may differ depending on the labor cost in a particular location. The salary provided is in addition to robust benefits and participation in Netlify’s equity plan. Our hiring range for this role is targeted at $182,000 - $248,000 for most US-based locations, $175,000 - $235,000 CAD in most Canada-based locations, and £105,000 – £144,000 GBP for most UK-based locations. Candidates outside the US, Canada, UK, or in premium markets should consult with their Talent Acquisition partner regarding location-based ranges, as they may be higher or lower than the average US range listed. The starting pay will be determined based on multiple factors, including expertise and skills, market demands, experience, internal equity, and applicable geographic location. These compensation packages and ranges are subject to change and may be modified in the future.
To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/netlify-staff-software-engineer-interfaces

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager (Mexico)
jobs.description:
Who we are
Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.
Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:
As a Samsara Technical Account Manager (TAM), you are the cornerstone of technical customer success. In this role, you will act as a trusted technical advisor, moving beyond traditional support to deliver measurable business value and drive the long-term adoption of the Samsara platform. Your mission is to proactively optimize your customers' technical health and mitigate risk, ensuring they achieve their desired outcomes.
This requires a unique blend of deep technical acumen, consultative problem-solving, and the ability to communicate with influence across both technical and executive stakeholders. You will build enduring customer relationships by translating their operational goals into powerful technical solutions. As the primary technical interface for your accounts, you will foster cross-functional collaboration with our Sales, Support, and Product teams to champion your customers' needs. During critical incidents, you will demonstrate ownership by managing customer communications and expectations through to a successful resolution.

This is a remote position open to candidates based in Mexico.

You should apply if:

• You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

• You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.

• You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.

• You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-caliber team that will encourage you to do your best.

In this role, you will:

• Drive Customer Impact & Value Realization: Go beyond technical support to consistently deliver measurable value. You will develop a deep understanding of your customers' business objectives and proactively align Samsara's solutions to help them achieve their goals, tracking and demonstrating technical ROI along the way.

• Use AI to Transform the Customer Experience: Leverage AI-powered tools and insights to anticipate customer needs, personalize engagement, and deliver faster, more proactive, and impactful outcomes.

• Execute Transformational Technical Account Management: Independently manage a portfolio of accounts, developing tailored success plans and identifying and mitigating risks to customer health. You will maintain accurate records of customer interactions and contribute to team-wide objectives.

• Demonstrate Deep Technical Acumen & Samsara Expertise: Be the primary technical point of contact, mastering Samsara's platform, including APIs, hardware, and software. You will advise customers on best practices and troubleshoot complex technical issues with proficiency.

• Provide Consultative Problem Solving & Solutioning: Employ a consultative approach to understand the root cause of customer challenges. You will own the technical ticket lifecycle, including technical escalations from report to resolution, and conduct root cause analysis to prevent recurrence and drive product improvement.

• Communicate with Influence and Clarity: Lead customer meetings, from technical deep dives to quarterly technical account reviews, with confidence. You will adapt your communication style to effectively engage with diverse audiences, from technical staff to non-technical executives.

• Foster Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner effectively with Sales, Support, Product, and Engineering teams to advocate for customer needs and deliver a unified experience.

• Demonstrate Ownership and Act as a Multiplier: Embody a 'get it done' mentality by taking initiative on team projects and process improvements. You will actively contribute to our internal knowledge base and help onboard new team members, sharing best practices to enhance the entire team's capabilities.

• Embody Samsara's Values & Principles: Consistently champion and role model Samsara's core values and operating principles in every interaction, actively seeking feedback for continuous improvement

Minimum requirements for the role:

• Experience: 7+ years experience in a technical, customer-facing role such as technical account management, solutions consulting, or customer success, with a demonstrated track record of success.

• Education: We welcome applications from candidates with a bachelor's degree in a technical field, or those who have gained equivalent expertise through practical experience in areas such as Computer Science, Engineering, or related fields.

• Technical Proficiency: Exceptional technical literacy with the ability to understand and troubleshoot complex hardware, software, and API integrations. A strong passion for technology and a commitment to continuous learning, including an interest in AI and its applications.

• Bilingual: English and Spanish is a must.

• Customer Focus: A data-informed approach to understanding customer needs and a demonstrated ability to build trusted, long-term relationships.

• Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills in English and Spanish is required.

• Collaborative Spirit: A team player who thrives in a fast-paced environment and works effectively with internal teams to drive customer success.

An ideal candidate also has:

• Experience supporting global enterprise-level customers in a SaaS, IoT, or PaaS environment.

• Proven experience leveraging AI tools and methodologies in daily workflows to drive efficiency, generate customer insights, and improve overall customer success.

• Prior experience with Samsara, Salesforce, Zendesk, Jira, Gong, Gainsight, and Tableau.

• Basic Python coding skills are an asset for providing enhanced technical solutions

Total Rewards
At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.
Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.
Flexible Working
At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.
Belonging at Samsara
At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.
Accommodations
Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.
Our Commitment to Authenticity
We use Tofu , a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.
Fraudulent Employment Offers
Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here .

jobs.title: Risk Analyst I, Underwriting
jobs.description:
Who we are:
Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.
Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.
Visit gomotive.com to learn more.

About the Role:
We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced underwriting professional to join our Risk Management team. As an experienced underwriter, you will be responsible for reviewing and assessing the financial risk of new and existing customers, while making decisions based on policy guidelines. You should have experience and subject matter expertise in financial services, end-to-end underwriting lifecycle, portfolio management, bank statement and financial decisioning, and risk assessment.
You’ll evaluate applications, perform analysis that mitigate financial risk, and make timely and accurate decisions on application outcomes. The successful candidate will work as a member of our Risk Organization and collaborate with members from our sales, data science, product management, and other stakeholders to deliver best in class customer experience.

What You'll Do:

• Collect, review and analyze applicants' relevant financial, demographic, and historic information and records. This includes, but is not limited to, analysis of business financial statements such as balance sheets, income statements and cash flow statements, bank statements, and credit reports

• Directly communicate with clients & sales about application status

• Clearly articulate why and when additional documents are needed in order to determine a client's creditworthiness

• Make determination whether to approve, decline or seek an exception for an application based on policy guidelines

• Make quality decisions in a timely and efficient manner within expected SLA

• Perform portfolio management, evaluating and identifying suspicious or questionable items

• Recommend policy and process improvement to mitigate potential failure points throughout the underwriting journey

• Bank statement analysis, financial spreading and risk ratio analysis culminating with underwriting memo

What We're Looking For:

• 2-3+ years of underwriting experience in financial services, high-growth payments, or fintech company

• Strong critical reasoning, problem solving and analytical skills

• Ability to work independently and thrive in a collaborative team environment

• Excellent oral and written communication skills

• Familiar with fundamentals of financial risk assessment

• Familiar with the U.S. compliance, lending & regulatory environment (KYC, Reg B, Reg Z, UDAAP, FCBA, Truth in Lending Act)

• Experience with quantitative and qualitative analysis

• Strong organization, and time management skills

Role overview
The Content Management Specialist owns the operational lifecycle of learning and knowledge content across the learning management system (LMS), knowledgebase, course communications, and New Hire Onboarding (NHO) materials. This role ensures content is accurate, current, easy to find, correctly assigned, and ready for learners and frontline teams.
Working closely with Instructional Designers, program owners, operations partners, and teams responsible for product and process launches, the specialist coordinates complex updates and builds consistent ways to manage content. The role also identifies gaps early and improves workflows to make content operations more reliable and visible.

What you’ll do

• Own content lifecycle workflows: Independently coordinate complex content updates from intake through review, publication, tracking, and retirement. Ensure the correct versions are active and accessible in the LMS and related platforms.

• Coordinate launch-driven updates: Work across stakeholders to identify learning and knowledge content affected by product, process, and operational changes. Clarify owners, dependencies, and timelines, and follow updates through to completion.

• Strengthen content governance: Establish and improve standards for version control, naming, tracking, archiving, and documentation. Maintain a clear view of active, pending, updated, and retired content.

• Manage course and communication assignments: Coordinate learner assignments and reassignments so the appropriate audiences receive the right training at the right time. Track completion and resolve follow-through gaps with relevant partners.

• Lead NHO update tracking: Monitor weekly launches and operational changes, map them to relevant onboarding courses or modules, and coordinate required updates. Keep a reliable record of pending and completed work.

• Protect content quality: Check courses and assessments before or after release. Validate quiz answers, scoring, logic, and completion criteria; flag outdated references, broken content flows, or other learner experience issues.

• Maintain knowledgebase alignment: Coordinate updates to knowledgebase articles using confirmed source material, retire outdated content appropriately, and help keep frontline documentation aligned with current learning materials.

• Improve how work gets done: Proactively identify gaps in content accuracy, coverage, and update readiness. Recommend and implement workflow improvements that reduce manual effort and improve visibility.

• Report status and risks: Keep stakeholders informed about progress, dependencies, upcoming updates, and issues that may affect release timelines or learner readiness.

What you’ll bring

• Experience managing learning content in an LMS or similar content platform.

• Strong attention to detail and a quality-focused approach to published content and assessments.

• Ability to independently organize and manage multiple content workflows, deadlines, and dependencies.

• Strong coordination and communication skills, including the ability to work across teams and follow updates through to completion.

• Experience maintaining trackers or other systems for organizing content, ownership, status, and timelines.

• Familiarity with course assignments, reassignments, learner-facing communications, or training operations.

• Familiarity with knowledgebase maintenance, content versioning, and archival practices.

• Comfort working in a fast-changing environment where priorities and launch timelines can shift.

• A process-improvement mindset and the ability to spot recurring gaps and recommend practical solutions.

How success is measured

• Learning content is reviewed and updated on time, with fewer outdated or duplicate items remaining live.

• Content updates and reassignments are completed accurately and within expected timelines.

• Course assignments reach the correct learner groups, and reassignment requests are tracked through completion.

• Knowledgebase content remains current and outdated articles are retired appropriately.

jobs.description:
Product Management Intern – Identity Resilience

About the Team & Role
The Product Management team at Rubrik drives forward our vision of delivering a market-leading platform that addresses the world’s most critical cyber resilience and data security challenges.
The Identity Resilience team is Rubrik’s fastest-growing business unit, operating with a high-velocity "0-to-1" charter. Today, modern cyberattacks almost exclusively weaponize identity systems. When identity fails, the entire enterprise halts. Our mission is to ensure enterprise identity environments are secure, observable, compliant, and instantly recoverable.
We are looking for a strategically sharp, technical, and execution-minded Product Management Intern for a high-impact 2-month internship based in Bengaluru. As an intern, you will own a core strategic initiative – bridging enterprise customer pain points, competitive differentiation, and technical architecture to deliver a concrete product roadmap for next-generation identity protection.

What You’ll Do (2-Month Charter)

• Market Landscape & Threat Vector Analysis: Benchmark the enterprise identity attack surface across hybrid environments. Map emerging threat vectors to potential resilience and recovery capabilities.

• Customer Discovery & Pain Point Synthesis: Work alongside PM and GTM mentors to analyze customer requirements, telemetry data, and enterprise security frameworks to pinpoint the highest-friction operational gaps for Security and IAM teams.

• Feature Strategy & PRD Ownership: Define the scope, user workflows, and success metrics for a targeted identity protection/recovery feature. Author a high-quality Product Requirement Document (PRD) balancing enterprise-grade depth with Rubrik’s trademark simplicity.

• Cross-Functional Architecture Alignment: Collaborate closely with Engineering, UX Design, and Architecture leads to evaluate technical trade-offs, define API/data pipeline requirements, and ensure feasibility.

jobs.description:
HackerRank helps companies like NVIDIA, Amazon, and Microsoft hire and upskill the next generation of developers based on skills, not pedigree. Our platform is trusted by over 2,500 of the world’s most innovative companies to build strong engineering teams ready for what’s next.

Software has entered an era where humans and AI build side by side. As this shift accelerates, the definition of strong technical talent is changing. We give companies better ways to identify and invest in next-generation skills.

People at HackerRank care deeply about the impact of their work and sweat the small details so our customers can be wildly successful with products they genuinely love to use. We move with urgency and believe great outcomes come from high standards.

About the role
HackerRank is advancing AI-driven Technical Interviewing, assessment of Integrity, and the measurement of Engineering skill to use AI assistance effectively in the agentic era. We are looking for research-oriented M.S./Ph.D. scholars to explore and develop novel Deep Learning architectures and build efficient, trustworthy AI systems. A key research direction is to develop a model-agnostic external Recursive Reasoning Engine that enables smaller models (SLM/SSM/Hybrid etc.) to solve complex, repository-grounded software engineering tasks with greater effectiveness, traceability, and lower inference cost.

Open problems
The agentic era is reshaping every layer of the hiring stack. These are some of the core problems you’ll be working across, none of them fully solved.

• Chakra: Building an autonomous AI interviewer that conducts, adapts to, and evaluates technical interviews end to end.

• Integrity: Detecting fraud and suspicious behavior across multiple signal types. The ways candidates game assessments change frequently, and the models need to keep up.

• Evaluation: Measuring technical skill in a world where AI writes the code. The old proxies no longer hold and the new ones have not been defined yet.

Your focus will shift across these depending on where the highest-leverage work is at any given time.

What you will do

• Research, Design, and Develop advanced Deep Learning models and novel Neural architectures.

• Explore architectures beyond Transformers, including State Space Models (SSMs), Liquid Neural Networks (LNNs), and Hybrid approaches.

• Design and implement Agentic AI systems, Recursive Reasoning Engines, and tool-augmented architectures.

• Fine-tuning of models using PEFT (e.g. LoRA, QLoRA etc.), and Knowledge Distillation

• Optimize model Performance, Inference Efficiency, Latency, and Memory utilization.

• Design rigorous experiments, evaluation frameworks, and benchmarks to validate research hypotheses.

• Translate cutting-edge research into scalable, production-grade AI systems.

Who you are

• M.Tech./M.S./Ph.D. in AI/ML or related disciplines.

• 2-3 years of experience in Deep Learning, Machine Learning, or Applied AI Research.

• Strong foundations in Linear Algebra, Probability, Statistics, Optimization, and Deep Learning algorithms.

• Proficient in frameworks like PyTorch/JAX, with hands-on model development experience.

• Demonstrated ability to implement, reproduce, and extend research papers, including building neural architectures from scratch.

• Strong understanding of experimental design, model evaluation, benchmarking, and statistical validation.

• Demonstrated research aptitude through publications, open-source contributions etc.

Even better if you have

• Understanding of Evaluation Benchmarks for S/W Engineering Tasks and Human-Agent Collaborations

• Familiarity with distributed computing, GPU acceleration, and scalable ML infrastructure.

You will thrive here if you

• You enjoy solving open-ended research problems and challenging established assumptions.

• You prefer first-principles thinking and rigorous experimentation over simply applying existing models.

• You are excited to explore next-generation AI architectures beyond traditional Transformers.

• You thrive in a fast-paced environment with intellectual freedom, ownership, and direct collaboration with leadership.

• You are passionate about turning novel AI research into efficient, scalable, real-world systems.

jobs.title: AI Native Builder/Architect
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Atlan is building the context layer for enterprise AI. Enterprises are pouring money into AI and most of it dies in production because the AI does not understand the business context around the data. That is the problem Atlan solves.

Gartner has named context the defining issue in enterprise AI, and calls context graphs the essential infrastructure for AI agents, naming Atlan one of three vendors already building it. We are also the only vendor named a Leader across all four major Gartner and Forrester evaluations for data catalogs, data governance and metadata management, the foundation the context layer runs on.

Come build the infrastructure that AI runs on.


WHO WE ARE

Gartner calls context the defining issue in enterprise AI, and context graphs the essential infrastructure for AI agents. It names Atlan as one of three vendors already building one. We're also the only vendor named a Leader in all four major Gartner and Forrester evaluations for data catalogs, data governance and metadata management, the layer our context graph is built on.

Come build the infrastructure AI runs on.



THE TEAM

You'll join the team building Atlan's context layer, the platforms that make it possible and the vertical agents that run on it. The platform is what any agent needs before an enterprise will trust it: a registry of which agents and skills exist, traces and evals on every run, and governance over cost and access.

Vertical agents each do one specific job, for customers and for Atlan's own teams. Inside Atlan they already run real work. There's an agent our CSMs trust, three GTM agents that replace 3,000 calls made by hand, an agent that watches every page on atlan.com http://atlan.com, and one that monitors the other agents. We write up what we learn in the open at Becoming Frontier https://atlan.com/frontier/.

The team works in small "two-slice" units. You own one initiative, usually with one or two people alongside you, and you decide how it gets built.



WHAT WILL YOU DO?

You'll take problems nobody has fully defined yet and ship working systems, fast. Depending on where you're matched, you may:

 - Own a 0→1 initiative from problem to production. Frame it, write the spec when there isn't one, pick the architecture and build it.

 - Build agents with the people who own the outcome, inside Atlan or at a customer. Scope the workflow with them, demo early and put the agent where the work already happens, like an approval in Slack or a redline in a legal team's Word doc.

 - Earn autonomy with evidence. Start with shadow runs, study the misses and widen what the agent can do as results support it.

 - Design for failure. Decide what happens when a tool is down, context is thin or the agent isn't sure, and how a person takes over.

 - Make the engineering calls on what stays deterministic code and what needs a model, build vs. reuse, model choice, cost and reliability. Explain the trade-offs clearly.

 - Make agent behavior observable. Tie traces and evals to the revision that ran. Track consistency, cost and latency alongside success rate, and treat drift as a regression.

 - Build on and extend the context layer, agent platform and registry: versioned skills, layered instructions, explicit permissions for tools and secrets, and model changes handled as migrations with evals rerun before promotion.

 - Build AI-native yourself. Run coding agents on your own work, keep their skills and instructions up to date, and review what they write for architectural drift.

 - Share what you learn. Turn what works into skills, reference architectures and quality gates that others adopt, and demo what you've built.


WHAT MAKES YOU A GREAT MATCH FOR US?


MUST HAVE

 - You've built software systems hands-on and shipped 0→1 products or platforms into production, often without a spec.

 - You've shipped agents or LLM systems that real people use. When one went wrong, you traced it back to the context, tool call or decision that caused it.

 - You use evals to find and fix real problems, check what a score actually counts, and judge agents by user impact: hours saved, error rate or cycle time.

 - You design for failure first: what the agent may touch, what happens when it's wrong, and where a person approves before it acts.

 - You build with coding agents every day and hold what they write to the same bar as your own code.

 - You're a critical optimist. You believe what agents can do is real, and test what still fails before trusting them with more.

 - You reason from first principles. When a familiar design doesn't fit, or a better model makes old scaffolding unnecessary, you notice and rebuild.

 - You have strong systems judgment. You can design for production reliability, latency, cost and security, build it yourself, and leave it in a shape others can build on.

 - You do your best work owning an initiative with one or two people alongside you, and don't need a large team to feel effective.

About the team:
The Information Security organization advances the overall state of security at Rubrik through critical initiatives and coordination of large security projects. Information Security builds technologies, tools, and processes to better enable teams at Rubrik to develop secure software and protect data and systems with appropriate security controls. Information Security also develops systems to monitor and respond to attacks against our assets, provides awareness education to teams on security best practices for data protection, and ensures data governance and data sharing relationships with third parties in order to securely protect Rubrik information.

About the role:
We are looking for a Manager, CyberSecurity Risk Management to join our security risk management team and support the delivery of Rubrik's cybersecurity risk management program. Working closely with the team's lead Program Manager, who owns the program, you will help drive day-to-day execution: coordinating cross-functional risk assessments, supporting risk review and acceptance processes, tracking risk remediation to closure, and producing risk reporting that gives leadership a clear view of Rubrik's cybersecurity risk posture. You will partner with Security, Engineering, Product, IT, Legal, Procurement, and Finance to keep work on track and deliver measurable outcomes. Success in this role requires strong program management discipline, solid risk and compliance knowledge, and the ability to influence and build consensus at every level of the company.

What you’ll do:

• Support program operations for the overall Cybersecurity Risk Management Program.

• Support and conduct risk assessments and triage incoming security issues related to Rubrik’s core products, services, and infrastructure.

• Draft clear risk statements that translate technical findings into business impact, including likelihood/impact rationale and key assumptions.

• Maintain and update the risk register, ensuring ownership, status, target dates, and risk treatment decisions are accurate and timely.

• Coordinate and track cross-functional risk initiatives, managing timelines, dependencies, and action items; flag delivery risks early and drive follow-through.

• Drive remediation of risks to closure by conducting periodic cross-functional check-ins with risk owners to obtain updates, track milestones and target dates, document progress in the risk register, remove/escalate blockers, and communicate status through leadership reporting.

• Support the risk governance cadence, including preparing materials for risk committee meetings, facilitating risk acceptance and exception reviews, and tracking escalations, decisions, and actions to completion.

• Collect and analyze program metrics (KPIs/KRIs), build dashboards, and help prepare risk updates for leadership.

• Support the risk assessment program at scale, including enterprise, technical, and third-party/supplier risk assessments, helping keep methodology, quality, and turnaround times consistent.

• Execute and document cybersecurity risk assessments (inherent and residual) for systems, applications, cloud services, and initiatives; gather evidence and validate control implementation with stakeholders.

• Help map program activities to compliance obligations and frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2, FedRAMP, NIST CSF/800-53, PCI DSS, HIPAA) and emerging regulations (e.g., DORA, NIS2, EU AI Act).

• Contribute to risk quantification efforts so risks can be prioritized in business and financial terms.

• Support GRC tooling, automation, and AI-enabled improvement initiatives by gathering requirements, coordinating implementation tasks, piloting use cases (e.g., LLM-assisted intake triage, evidence mapping, and automated status summarization), and driving adoption of standardized workflows with appropriate governance and human review.

jobs.description:
About the team:
The Information Security organization advances the overall state of security at Rubrik through critical initiatives and coordination of large security projects. Information Security builds technologies, tools, and processes to better enable teams at Rubrik to develop secure software and protect data and systems with appropriate security controls. Information Security also develops systems to monitor and respond to attacks against our assets, provides awareness education to teams on security best practices for data protection, and ensures data governance and data sharing relationships with third parties in order to securely protect Rubrik information.

About the role:
Rubrik is seeking a Senior Commercial Compliance Analyst to lead Commercial Audit and Certification Management. In this role, you will own Rubrik's portfolio of security certifications and coordinated audits end-to-end, from evidence collection through auditor management to final report delivery, ensuring audit readiness is continuous and audit findings are tracked to closure.

What you'll do:

• Own the audit and certification calendar across Rubrik's active portfolio: SOC 1, SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 27017, ISO 27018, ISO 27701, ISO 42001, CSA STAR Level 1 and Level 2, TISAX Level 1 and Level 2, HITRUST, HIPAA.

• Serve as the primary point of contact for external auditors and certification bodies, managing scoping, fieldwork, evidence requests, and remediation of findings through to closure.

• Maintain the mapping between compliance controls and underlying evidence sources so audit readiness is continuous rather than a point-in-time scramble.

• Drive coordinated audit strategy, consolidating overlapping evidence requests across frameworks to reduce duplicate work for control owners.

• Lead evaluation and scoping of emerging and planned certifications to support Rubrik's international and AI governance expansion.

• Manage the lifecycle of certifications end-to-end, including retirements and transitions

• Track and report audit status, findings, and remediation progress to leadership, using the team's Jira-based tracking dashboards.

• Partner with control owners across InfoSec, IT, Legal, and Engineering to gather evidence and close audit findings on schedule.

• Collaborate with Risk Management to ensure audit findings feed into the broader risk register and remediation lifecycle (RMLC).

• Support Customer Trust Enablement by ensuring audit and certification outputs are readily usable to answer customer security inquiries.

• Leverage AI and automation to streamline evidence gathering, control testing, and audit workflows.

Experience you'll need:

• 5+ years of experience in security compliance, audit management, or GRC

• Hands-on experience managing SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 42001 audits, plus at least one additional framework

• Experience working directly with external auditors and certification bodies, including scoping and negotiating audit timelines.

• Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent audit cycles.

• Familiarity with GRC tooling and ticketing systems (e.g., Jira) for tracking evidence and remediation.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills

• Knowledge of regulatory and contractual compliance requirements relevant to enterprise SaaS/security vendors.

• Detailed oriented

Who we are

About Stripe
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team
Metronome is a usage-based billing platform and a Stripe product. It helps modern software companies launch products faster, offer flexible pricing models, and streamline finance workflows.
The Metronome Integration Engineering team sits at the intersection of sales, growth, product, and research and development. We own the technical aspects of the customer lifecycle after a sale and before the customer transitions to our post-implementation teams.

What you'll do
As an Integration Engineer, you’ll help customers implement Metronome successfully and realize value quickly. You’ll lead technical work across requirements gathering, solution and integration design, configuration, testing, data migration, launch, and handoff.

Responsibilities

• Conduct discovery and scoping to understand customers’ challenges across billing, product launches, pricing and packaging, quote-to-cash, customer experience, and related areas.

• Support customers throughout the implementation lifecycle, including requirements gathering, technical design, integration design, testing, data migration, and launch.

• Provide expert guidance on usage-based pricing and consumption-based business models.

• Configure Metronome’s platform on behalf of customers.

• Design integrations between Metronome’s APIs and customers’ business systems—including CRM and CPQ platforms, payment and tax systems, ERP and billing providers, and reporting and analytics tools—in alignment with Metronome best practices.

• Serve as a liaison between customers and Metronome’s research and development teams, advocating for customer needs and feature requests.

• Partner with implementation managers and other project-team members to provide visibility into progress and proactively identify risks and issues.

• Build relationships across customer organizations, from day-to-day operators to C-suite executives. Meet customers in person when doing so will improve the engagement.

• Advise customers on integrating Metronome into their systems and help shape their pricing and packaging strategies.

• Ensure an effective handoff to Customer Success and Technical Support.

You’ll work with some of Metronome’s most strategic customers. These engagements will be complex, deep, and highly technical. Metronome directly influences how modern software companies monetize their products, and this team is on the front lines of that work.
Metronome operates with a startup mindset within Stripe. There is a significant opportunity for people with initiative to influence our direction, build processes from zero to one, and make a meaningful impact.

Who you are
We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements below. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are helpful but not required.

Minimum requirements

• 5+ years of experience in technical or customer-facing roles involving SaaS products, such as sales engineering, solutions architecture, technical account management, or deployment strategy.

• Experience leading complex implementations for enterprise technology companies.

• Experience working in fast-moving environments that value initiative and ownership.

• Ability to quickly learn and communicate technical concepts to technical, go-to-market, and finance stakeholders.

• Interest in building and improving go-to-market playbooks, processes, and reusable assets.

• Ability to travel approximately 30% of the time, depending on customer needs.

Preferred qualifications

• Deep knowledge of quote-to-cash processes, including experience integrating with or working alongside platforms such as Salesforce, NetSuite, CPQ systems, and the Stripe ecosystem.

• Experience as a software engineer, product manager, or in another technical role.

• Strong understanding of project- and program-management fundamentals.

• Experience working with stakeholders in finance, engineering, product, sales operations, or billing operations.

• Experience with logs, metrics, billing, finance, infrastructure, or financial tooling and concepts.

About the Role
Motive is scaling fast, and our Quote-to-Cash engine needs to keep up. The QTC pipeline processes 5,000+ daily orders across 100k+ customers and is critical to IPO readiness and SOX compliance.
As a Senior Enterprise Systems Engineer on the QTC team, you will be a senior member of the engineering team that builds and maintains Motive's Quote-to-Cash stack: Salesforce CPQ, Zuora Billing, Zuora Revenue (RevPro), NetSuite, Vertex, and n8n/MuleSoft integrations. You will tackle some of the most impactful engineering challenges in the company: ensuring every order flows seamlessly from quote to billing to revenue recognition without manual intervention or data gaps.
This is a hands-on individual contributor role for an engineer who has lived in the Quote-to-Cash or Lead-to-Cash space for years and understands how quoting, billing, revenue recognition, and ERP systems connect. You will solve problems around order automation, billing accuracy, integration reliability, and proactive monitoring that keeps our revenue pipeline healthy as we scale toward an IPO.
We believe in an "everyone is a builder" mentality. Everyone on this team is capable of being a forward-thinking engineer, not just executing tickets but shaping how systems are designed and built. You will build headless apps that surface QTC data and workflows where users already work, and you will leverage AI to accelerate how we work, from agentic development workflows to AI-assisted order processing and intelligent automation across the stack.

What You'll Do

• Design, build, and maintain scalable technical solutions across the Quote-to-Cash stack, which today includes Salesforce (Sales Cloud, CPQ), Zuora Billing and Revenue (RevPro), NetSuite, Vertex, and n8n/MuleSoft integrations.

• Configure and customize Salesforce platform components, including Apex, Flows, Triggers, Batch classes, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and SOQL/SOSL, to solve complex business requirements across the QTC lifecycle.

• Build and maintain integrations between Salesforce, Zuora, NetSuite, and third-party systems using SOAP/REST APIs and middleware (n8n, MuleSoft).

• Drive integration health across the QTC ecosystem, building proactive monitoring, alerting, and SOPs to detect and resolve failures before they impact customers or revenue.

• Partner with Product Management, QA, and business stakeholders to plan, prioritize, and deliver applications and enhancements in an Agile, sprint-based environment.

• Deliver quality applications and support within a SOX compliance control environment with rigorous change management.

• Establish and uphold engineering best practices, standards, and operational guidelines with a focus on platform reliability, performance, and serviceability.

• Stay current on QTC system releases, new features, product roadmaps, and third-party applications. Evaluate and recommend emerging capabilities, including Salesforce RevCloud, Agentforce, and AI-assisted order processing.

• Participate in code reviews, technical design reviews, and the Architecture Review Board to ensure solutions adhere to architectural principles and patterns.

• Drive continuous improvement in communication, collaboration, and alignment across teams inside and outside the QTC organization.

What We're Looking For

• 7+ years of Salesforce configuration and customization experience: Apex, Flows, Triggers, Batch classes, LWC, SOQL/SOSL.

• Deep experience in Quote-to-Cash or Lead-to-Cash in a SaaS or recurring revenue company, spanning quoting, order processing, fulfillment, billing, and revenue recognition.

• Hands-on experience with Salesforce CPQ: quoting, pricing rules, order generation, and approval workflows.

• Integration experience using SOAP/REST APIs and middleware (n8n, MuleSoft) to connect Salesforce with external billing, ERP, and tax systems.

• Understanding of billing and revenue recognition concepts: ASC 606, subscription billing, deferred revenue, and AR reconciliation.

• Experience with Zuora Billing and/or Zuora Revenue (RevPro), and/or NetSuite ERP (GL, journal entries, AR reconciliation).

• Strong understanding of Salesforce security best practices, including the Salesforce security model, threat modeling, and least-privilege / zero-trust access models.

• Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies and CI/CD tools (Copado, Gearset, AutoRabit) in a source-controlled environment.

• Experience integrating Salesforce with third-party applications using SOAP/REST APIs and middleware.

• Excellent spoken and written communication skills with the ability to present complex ideas clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

• Ability to deal with ambiguity and thrive in a rapidly changing business environment.

Nice to Haves

• Salesforce Revenue Cloud (RevCloud) experience or familiarity with Revenue Cloud Advanced.

• Salesforce Agentforce or AI agent building experience.

• SOX compliance / ITGC controls experience in Salesforce.

• Vertex tax engine experience.

• Salesforce CPQ Specialist certification.
